# Conclave

> Conclave is a free, local-first desktop application that runs a network of autonomous
> AI coding agents (Claude Code, Antigravity, OpenAI Codex, Gemini, Cursor, Grok, Copilot)
> completely offline on your own machine. Each agent is a real CLI running in its own
> dedicated PTY terminal, authenticated with your existing local keys and subscriptions.
> The Lead agent coordinates the team, manages task routing, memory, and brings only
> what needs human input.
> Current version: 0.5.0.

Engines supported:
- Claude Code
- Antigravity (Gemini CLI)
- OpenAI Codex
- GitHub Copilot CLI
- Cursor
- Custom CLI commands & local LLMs (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM)

Key Features:
- Branch Metro View: Interactive vector subway map tracking agents, tasks, merges, redirects, and conflict signals
- Autonomous multi-agent coordination with local PTY isolation
- Persistent memory graph and cross-session knowledge storage
- Zero remote telemetry, zero phone-homes, completely private
- Offline-first bundled assets and fonts
